Architect verdict: APPROVE (after 1 continuation + 1 architect-trailing fmt fix).

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0 (after architect-trailing cargo fmt for derive-list reflows in polaris-types/src/{action,incident,subject}.rs).
- SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build --workspace: clean.
- .sqlx cache 27 entries (was 12; 15 new for the repo + test queries).
- 9 test binaries compile including repo_roundtrip + actions_append_only.
- Forbidden-pattern grep: zero Arc<PgPool> outside doc comments, zero UPDATE actions anywhere, zero unwrap/expect outside #[cfg(test)], zero anyhow in repo APIs.
- 6 repo files present.

Subagent ran integration tests live against testcontainers Postgres 16 and reported pass. Architect did not re-run live tests; trust calibrated at compile + read-shape (SQL macros validated against live DB during sqlx prepare).

Coordination point surfaced for #14: AFIT used per directive; async-trait dep in workspace.dependencies unused. If #14's Axum handlers need dyn-dispatched repos, either generic handlers (with monomorphization) or async-trait re-application on the repo traits — that decision happens in #14, not unilaterally here.
